# Country database

`dbip-country-lite.mmdb` is DB-IP Country Lite, September 2026.

- Source: https://db-ip.com/db/download/ip-to-country-lite
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Attribution: IP Geolocation by DB-IP, https://db-ip.com
- Uncompressed SHA-1: 385d4ab1e08417634a0a64921ac0e9c15c4c5e8a

The analytics page includes the required DB-IP attribution link. IP lookups run entirely locally. To refresh the data, download a newer MMDB release from the source page, decompress its gzip file, validate its published checksum, and replace `dbip-country-lite.mmdb` atomically. DB-IP publishes Lite updates monthly.
